name: 清婉
description: A graceful gentle classical beauty: eyebrows are slim soft willow arcs with natural slightly fuller heads and very smooth tapered tails, moderate width not thread-thin. Eyes are softly open ALMOND shapes with a rounded yet elegant upper arc, the outer ends level to subtly lifted, a natural fine double-lid fold, poised calm warm gaze; a little more openness than the earlier narrow-eye designs but never giant. Nose has a short-to-medium graceful bridge, refined soft rounded tip and understated slim alae, tiny complete nostrils. Mouth is a small-to-medium width soft petal shape with gentle rounded cupid's bow and slightly fuller lower lip, relaxed corners. Every contour is fluid, mild and harmonious. Gentle adult feminine elegance, no childish cuteness.
